name: citoyenavise
description: Plateforme civique Citoyen Avisé — Frontend + Backend

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run prepare
scripts.dev: npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.start:prod-local: npm run build && npm --prefix backend start
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format

author: Citoyen Avisé
